verdict.rationale: Modal's own pricing page says any containerizable application can be deployed, and the homepage says you can bring your entire inference stack. That implies custom containerized environments, but no evidence explicitly documents running a user-supplied Docker image or a custom image/template definition. missing for 10: explicit docs on bringing your own Docker image or registry image, documentation of custom image building and pinning an exact environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run my own Docker image or custom machine template with my exact environment

citations.quote: You can deploy any application that can be containerized, using Python.
Bring your entire inference stack. Modal handles the infrastructure.
